requirement: Add a Refund(id) event. Refund moves an order in state "paid" or "shipped" to the new state "refunded"; from any other state it is the error "cannot refund ID from STATE", and for an unknown id it is "unknown order: ID", like the other events. No event may leave "refunded".
desc: Track orders through their life cycle, processing events in order. Create(id) adds a new order in state "created"; if an order with that id already exists, return the error "duplicate order: ID". For Pay, Ship, Cancel and Refund, if no order with that id exists, return the error "unknown order: ID". Allowed changes: Pay moves "created" to "paid"; Ship moves "paid" to "shipped"; Cancel moves "created" or "paid" to "cancelled"; Refund moves "paid" or "shipped" to "refunded". Any other change returns the error "cannot VERB ID from STATE", where VERB is pay, ship, cancel or refund and STATE is the order's current state. Stop at the first error. Otherwise return every order as an (id, state) pair, sorted by id in ascending character-code order (so uppercase letters sort before lowercase, and "A10" before "A9").

decls.canon:
type OrderEvent =
  | Create(id: String)
  | Pay(id: String)
  | Ship(id: String)
  | Cancel(id: String)
  | Refund(id: String)
